words: By the way, have you seen the new film?
A trip to Italy? That sounds great!
I see. And how long have you worked there?
Понятно. А сколько ты там работаешь?
I have to go. Nice talking to you!
I love hiking. What about you?
Do you like big cities? — It depends.
Sorry, I have to go now.

lessons.title: Small talk: поддержать разговор
lessons.theory:
В английском разговор поддерживают короткими реакциями и встречными вопросами. Молчание или ответ одним словом звучит холодно.

  • Реакции: Really? That sounds great! I see. Oh no!
  • Встречный вопрос: What about you? And you?
  • Вопросы-эхо: I live in Spain. — Oh, do you? (повторяем вспомогательный глагол)
  • Завершить: Anyway, I have to go. Nice talking to you!

ex.q: — I've just come back from Japan. — ___
— I work in a bank. — Oh, ___ you?
ex.why: Эхо-вопрос повторяет вспомогательный глагол: I work → do you?

ex.q: — I'm going to Paris next week. — Oh, ___ you?

o: Anyway, I have to go. Nice talking to you!
ex.a: Anyway, I have to go. Nice talking to you!
ex.why: Anyway + причина + Nice talking to you — вежливо.
How's it going? — «Как дела?», а не «куда идёшь».

texts.title: Meeting a neighbour
texts.text: Hi! You're the new neighbour, right? I'm Mike from number twelve. — Oh, hi Mike! Yes, I'm Olga. We moved in last week. — Nice to meet you, Olga. How do you like the area? — It's great. It's quiet, and the park is really close. — Oh, do you run? I run there every morning. — Really? I've just started running! — Great, we can run together sometime. Anyway, I have to go to work. Nice talking to you! — You too. Take care!

title: Small talk: как поддержать разговор
